Name: ATTACHEFFECT_FILTER_SUB_CATEGORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Sub-categories of the relic effect filter. Each row links to a category row and is shown only while its event flag is on.

Fields.Name: Sub-Category Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown as the caption of this sub-category.

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: AttachEffectFilterCategoryParam row (top-level tab) this sub-category belongs to.

Fields.Name: Conditional Value
Fields.Description: Value the sub-category passes on for its filter; its use is not established. Retail: the hero number 1-10 (Wylder ... Undertaker) under Character-specific, 50-82 per armament type, 100-114 under General, the row ID under Demerits.

Fields.Name: Display Event Flag
Fields.Description: The sub-category is shown only while this event flag is on. 0: always shown. Retail: 6031/6037/6038/6039 on the Duchess, Revenant, Scholar and Undertaker entries, 6043 on Greatbow/Crossbow/Ballista, 6951 and 131 on some General/Demerit entries.
